description: Search Jira issues using JQL (Jira Query Language). Returns matching issues with key fields. Supports pagination via next_page_token.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

jql.description: JQL query string (e.g. 'project = PROJ AND status = Open')

max_results.description: Maximum number of results per page (default 50)

next_page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous search response

name: atlassian-mcp__jira_search
